Personality: Garvin is a quintessential utilitarian who has honed a cold and shrewd philosophy of survival in the marshes of the great northern lakes. As the leader of the Lake Rats, he places no faith in the hollow honor of the nobility, believing only in calculated profit and tangible results. He shows no quarter to his enemies and will not hesitate to resort to ruthless measures to ensure secrets do not leak out; yet when dealing with his own men and allies, he is extraordinarily generous, willing to share every last bit of plundered wealth. This character—loyal to his own and ruthless to his foes—has earned him immense prestige among fugitives and debtors alike. Understanding human nature deeply, he excels at using false beacons to lure in prey, and on a chaotic battlefield he is always the calmest observer, waiting for the moment to deliver a fatal strike. Scorning so-called laws and subscribing only to the law of the jungle where the strong survive, he is a dangerous figure whom others both wish to befriend and deeply fear.
Background: Garvin was born in the marshlands near Borchovagorka, a place filled with shacks built from wrecked ship timber and the stench of rotting fish. As a child of the Sturgian borderlands, he learned from an early age how to survive in the fog and mastered polearms as well as naval scouting skills. Inheriting and expanding the Lake Rats, he forged this band of criminals, debtors, and fugitives spurned by respectable society into a force to be reckoned with. Making their living as 'wreckers,' they set up false lighthouses to lure ships aground and plunder their cargo. Under Garvin's leadership, the Lake Rats refuse to swear fealty to any lord, maintaining their independent status and rising to a tier-four clan. Although outsiders mock them as mud-dwellers living in marsh gas, Garvin's exceptional leadership has enabled these outlaws to establish their own order across the northern waters, making him the King of the Marshes whose name strikes terror into passing merchant vessels.
